notes: This portable C++ TCK scenario uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador API, the standard library, and adapter-supplied application FOM, standard MIM, provider package, endpoint, and callback configuration. It sets HLAserviceReporting through HLAsetSwitches, verifies the public switch getter and peer-federate isolation, then observes one successful receive-order SendInteraction service report at the subscribed peer while file reporting is disabled. It checks the report's source federate and Table 5 arguments; this is one service path only and does not establish all service-reporting behavior or conformance.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador standard-MIM interaction and parameter lookup, publish/subscribe, receive-order sendInteraction, Service Reporting and file-report switch queries, report metadata lookup/decode, and federation lifecycle
